note: THE EYE-CHECK LAW: are the eye finder's two eyes this face's eyes? Per class (right, wrong), point of the 48 x 42 crop and map bin, round(2 log2((n + 1) / (N + 8))), counted on Extended Yale B's 37 people: real photographs (as they are, printed) and renders in the phone's light; right = both eyes within 0.12 eye distances, wrong = gross misses (an eye more than 0.30 off, or the spacing off by 1.33x); a pair passes when its evidence for right minus wrong >= TAU, the smallest that rejected every held-out gross miss (halves by person)
